broadcasts_template_body_check.name: broadcasts_template_body_check
broadcasts_template_body_check.value: "broadcasts"."template_html" is not null or "broadcasts"."template_text" is not null

domain_dkim_keys_private_key_state_check.name: domain_dkim_keys_private_key_state_check
domain_dkim_keys_private_key_state_check.value: ("domain_dkim_keys"."status" = 'retired' and "domain_dkim_keys"."encrypted_private_key" is null) or ("domain_dkim_keys"."status" <> 'retired' and "domain_dkim_keys"."encrypted_private_key" is not null)

email_templates_html_length_check.name: email_templates_html_length_check
email_templates_html_length_check.value: "email_templates"."html" is null or char_length("email_templates"."html") between 1 and 2097152

email_templates_text_length_check.name: email_templates_text_length_check
email_templates_text_length_check.value: "email_templates"."text" is null or char_length("email_templates"."text") between 1 and 2097152

email_templates_body_check.name: email_templates_body_check
email_templates_body_check.value: "email_templates"."html" is not null or "email_templates"."text" is not null

messages_body_check.name: messages_body_check
messages_body_check.value: "messages"."html" is not null or "messages"."text" is not null

messages_idempotency_state_check.name: messages_idempotency_state_check
messages_idempotency_state_check.value: ("messages"."idempotency_key" is null and "messages"."request_hash" is null) or ("messages"."idempotency_key" is not null and "messages"."request_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

messages_idempotency_key_length_check.name: messages_idempotency_key_length_check
messages_idempotency_key_length_check.value: "messages"."idempotency_key" is null or char_length("messages"."idempotency_key") between 1 and 256

messages_worker_id_check.name: messages_worker_id_check
messages_worker_id_check.value: "messages"."worker_id" is null or (char_length("messages"."worker_id") between 1 and 128 and "messages"."worker_id" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]')

messages_failure_reason_check.name: messages_failure_reason_check
messages_failure_reason_check.value: "messages"."failure_reason" is null or char_length("messages"."failure_reason") between 1 and 1000

messages_worker_lease_state_check.name: messages_worker_lease_state_check
messages_worker_lease_state_check.value: ("messages"."status" = 'sending' and "messages"."attempt_count" > 0 and "messages"."last_attempt_at" is not null and "messages"."worker_id" is not null and "messages"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("messages"."status" <> 'sending' and "messages"."worker_id" is null and "messages"."lease_expires_at" is null)

messages_sent_state_check.name: messages_sent_state_check
messages_sent_state_check.value: ("messages"."status" = 'sent' and "messages"."sent_at" is not null) or ("messages"."status" <> 'sent' and "messages"."sent_at" is null)

messages_failed_state_check.name: messages_failed_state_check
messages_failed_state_check.value: ("messages"."status" = 'failed' and "messages"."failed_at" is not null and "messages"."failure_reason" is not null) or ("messages"."status" <> 'failed' and "messages"."failed_at" is null)
